executive_verdict.primary_failure_mode: The documentation and claim layer is ahead of the runtime layer: several features are described as working (double opt-in, content editor, map facade, auto-fix) but are stubs, dead code, or no-ops.
executive_verdict.most_urgent_fix: Wire the newsletter flow to real confirmation (consent/compliance exposure), then decide whether the admin Content Editor drives rendered content or remove the claim.

scope.app_type: conventional Next.js Pages Router web application (not an agent/LLM system)
scope.agent_stack_note: package.json has zero AI/LLM dependencies; no prompts, tool router, memory/vector store, or LLM calls exist. All 12 agent-stack layers are N/A.

findings.title: Newsletter double opt-in is a no-op; unverified addresses stored as active
findings.mechanism: The API logs a confirmation token to stdout instead of sending it, never sets confirmedAt, and the signup UI component is never imported by a page.
findings.root_cause: The confirmation step was designed but the mailer function, confirm endpoint, and UI wiring were never implemented.
findings.recommended_fix: Wire to lib/mailer.js with a confirmation email, add GET /api/newsletter/confirm?token=, set confirmedAt and active only on confirmation, or remove the feature and its copy.

findings.title: Admin Content Editor edits data the public site never reads; PageBlock CMS dead
findings.mechanism: Admin pages write Page SEO fields, but public pages hardcode Seo props. getPageSeo is used only by the sitemap. PageBlock has no renderer, editor, API, or seed rows.
findings.source_layer: missing wiring between CMS persistence and rendering
findings.root_cause: The spec called for a WYSIWYG/markdown content editor; only an SEO-field editor was built and it was never connected to page rendering.
findings.recommended_fix: Consume getPageSeo(slug) in public pages, and either implement a PageBlock renderer/editor or delete the dead schema and the WYSIWYG claim.

findings.title: Google Maps facade is not a facade
findings.mechanism: Both exported components render the Google iframe immediately; there is no state or click handler despite the doc comment promising click-to-load.
findings.root_cause: The facade pattern was documented but never implemented.
findings.recommended_fix: Implement useState + click-to-load, or remove the performance/privacy comment.

findings.title: Audit trail is write-only; no UI to view it
findings.mechanism: AdminShell claims all actions are recorded, but no page calls /api/admin/audit and the dashboard renders no entries.
findings.root_cause: The audit API was built with a 'dashboard footer' intention that was never implemented.
findings.recommended_fix: Add an audit view to the admin dashboard using the existing endpoint.

findings.title: In-memory rate limiter deployed with 2 replicas
findings.mechanism: Per-process buckets are not shared, so effective limits are inconsistent and bypassable by distributing requests.
findings.root_cause: The in-memory limiter was designed for one process; K8s sets replicas: 2 and HPA minReplicas: 2.
findings.recommended_fix: Use a shared store or edge rule, or run a single replica and document the constraint.

findings.title: No branded server-error page
findings.mechanism: 404 is branded but a 500 falls through to the Next default page.
findings.root_cause: Never built though a branded 404 exists.
findings.recommended_fix: Add pages/500.js using the branded 404 as a template.

findings.title: Duplicate FAQPage JSON-LD on /faqs
findings.mechanism: The page and the accordion each inject FAQPage structured data for the same content.
findings.root_cause: Two independent implementations of the same SEO feature.

findings.title: Operator precedence bug in getPageSeo noIndex calculation
findings.mechanism: Boolean(page?.noIndex) || key === 'home' ? Boolean(page?.noIndex) : false collapses to Boolean(page?.noIndex), making the home branch dead.
findings.root_cause: Missing parentheses around the OR condition.
findings.recommended_fix: Parenthesize the intended condition or simplify with explicit intent.

findings.title: Spec-recommended accessibility/performance audits and DB integration tests absent
findings.mechanism: The spec requests axe/Lighthouse and Supertest/MySQL integration tests; the suite is Jest with mocked API handlers plus Playwright, with no a11y/perf CI gate.
findings.root_cause: Local-only test policy plus no audit tooling in CI.
findings.recommended_fix: Add axe/Lighthouse to CI and reconcile the test-strategy docs with the local-only suite policy.

findings.title: Scope docs are untracked and contain 17 contradictions
findings.mechanism: git ls-files docs returns 0; README points to the untracked spec. Roles, port, framework versions, test counts, and route counts disagree across docs.
findings.root_cause: docs/ was deliberately untracked in commit 124b7a1 while remaining the authoritative source for audits.
findings.recommended_fix: Track the scope docs or inline the spec into tracked README; nominate one authoritative source and reconcile contradictions.

findings.title: Security workflow does not auto-fix
findings.mechanism: next upgrade --agent=security prints guidance only; the fix branch requires a git diff that command never produces.
findings.root_cause: Workflow titled 'Scan -> Report -> Fix -> Verify' but fix step is inert.
findings.recommended_fix: Rename the workflow to reflect report-only behavior or implement a real patch step.

findings.title: K8s scheduled scale-to-zero is a comment only
findings.mechanism: Manifest describes scheduled scale-down but ships only an HPA with minReplicas: 2; no CronJob or KEDA.
findings.recommended_fix: Implement a CronJob/KEDA ScaledObject or remove the comment.

findings.title: Sitemap doc comment overstates coverage
findings.mechanism: Comment claims published service and FAQ URLs; implementation maps only 14 static PUBLIC_ROUTES.
findings.root_cause: Doc comment describes an intended extension.
findings.recommended_fix: Generate the claimed URLs or correct the comment.

findings.title: Hardcoded fallback copy and phone numbers bypass settings registry
findings.mechanism: Two pages use literal fallback text/phone instead of the env-driven settings layer.
findings.recommended_fix: Read from the settings registry with a documented fallback.
